STIPULATION FOR ENTRY OF JUDGMENT ENTERED ON THE RECORD WITH THE FOLLOWING CONDITIONS: 1. DEFT TO VACATE PREMISES BY 11/30/96; 2. DEFT TO PAY DAMAGES OF $4,850.00 TO BE PAID: $2,500. BEFORE 5:30 PM ON 10/17/96 AT PLAINTIFF COUNSEL'S OFFICE; REMAINING $2,350.00 BY 11/15/96; BOTH PAYMENTS BY CASHIER'S CHECK OR CASH; 3. PLTF WAIVES ATTY'S FEES & COSTS; 4. PLTF GRANTS FULL RELEASE OF ALL CLAIMS EXCEPT TO FILE ACTION FOR PROPERTY DAMAGE AND/OR THEFT; 5. NO STAY; 6. SEC DEPOSIT TO BE DISPOSED OF PER STATE LAW; IF DEFT COMPLIES, PLTF WILL FILE DISMISSAL WITH PREJUDICE. IF DEFT FAILS TO MAKE EITHER PAYMENT, PLTF WILL APPLY EX PARTE FOR ENTRY OF JUDGMENT FOR POSSESSION, BACK RENTS, COST & ATTY'S FEES WITH AT LEAST 24 HOUR NOTICE TO DEFT. STIP TO BE REDUCED TO WRITING.

DEPT 1/JUDGE MASON: PER TELEPHONE CONVERSATION WITH COURT, ATNY WILLIAM FAZIO STATED THAT HE HAS NEVER BEEN ATNY FOR DEFT AND DOES NOT REPRESENT HER. DEFT INFORMED BY COURT TO OBTAIN COUNSEL BY 2:30PM OR APPEAR IN PRO-PER AND BE PREPARED TO PROCEED TO TRIAL.
DEPT 1/JUDGE MASON: ATNY WILLIAM FAZIO APPEARED IN DEPT 1 AT AFTERNOON CALLING OF CASE STATING THAT HE WOULD FILE APPEARANCE AS ATTORNEY OF RECORD FOR DEFT.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT HORSFALL, SUSAN AKA SUSAN HORSEFALL THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 1360 FULTON ST, SF $2,350.00 RENT, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,350.00, LEASE FORFEITED, PLAINTIFF AWARDED ATTY'S FEES & COSTS PER MEMO OF COSTS; DEFENDANT WAIVED RIGHT TO SEEK STAY; SEE JUDGMENT FOR DETAIL S.
